pain: Machine controllers need scoped authentication and durable safe reconciliation.
done_when: Only an explicitly bound workload can poll or report for its machine; exact audience strings and singleton arrays work while human, mixed, empty and repeated audiences fail.
Reports preserve original receipt and history under duplicate delivery, restart, revoked or replaced bindings and stale intent.
Controller closes admission before stopping, waits for idle, never treats unknown job state as idle and persists the report outbox before accepting newer work.
Unknown, future and stale host evidence cannot complete operations; no arbitrary shell commands, native installation or live activation is introduced.
Lost acknowledgement retries preserve report content and receipt without replaying host effects; browser coverage proves evidence expiry and scope boundaries.

out_of_scope: Live credentials and Access policy changes
